description: Confirms /scrutinize supports the flag-as-fp approval command and that a flagged false positive is written into the shared run record (outputs/operations/scrutiny/runs.jsonl) as an fp_flag row by scripts/scrutinize-flag-fp.py, beside the verdict rows it disagrees with. The separate aggregator and its _fp_aggregate.md were deleted 2026-08-09 after 75 runs produced zero flags.
input: What does the flag-as-fp command do in /scrutinize, and where does the data go?
